title: Second-, third- and fourth-minimum conjecture for the $A_\alpha$ spectral radius of strongly connected digraphs
literal_statement:
Let $G$ be a strongly connected digraph of order $n\geq 5$, and let $A_\alpha$ denote its $A_\alpha$ matrix and $\lambda_\alpha(G)$ its $A_\alpha$ spectral radius. For $0\leq \alpha<1$, let $\theta(0,1,n-3)$, $\theta(1,1,n-4)$ and $\theta(0,2,n-4)$ be the digraphs defined in the paper.

**Second-, third- and fourth-minimum conjecture.** Among all the strongly connected digraphs with order $n\geq 5$ and $0\leq \alpha<1$, $\theta(0,1,n-3)$, $\theta(1,1,n-4)$ and $\theta(0,2,n-4)$ are the digraphs which achieve the second, the third and the fourth minimum $A_\alpha$ spectral radius, respectively.

The result extends the preceding theorem, which establishes the same ordering for $0\leq \alpha\leq \frac{1}{2}$. The conjecture is proposed on the basis of numerical examples for the general range $0\leq \alpha<1$; no resolution is given in the supplied text.
